item.title: German court halts ‘right-wing extremist’ label on AfD
item.description: In a temporary ruling on Thursday, judges in Cologne stopped Germany’s domestic intelligence agency from using the extremism designation it placed on the party in May of last year.

item.title: Explosions reported at UK air base as Iran conflict escalates
item.description: The reports come after UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer granted the United States permission to launch “defensive” strikes on Iranian missile sites from UK bases.

item.title: Hezbollah fires on Northern Israel, IDF retaliates with strikes across Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah claimed responsibility, saying the attack was in retaliation for the killing of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei during the joint Israeli-US assault on Iran on Saturday.

item.description: “The incident is not being treated as terror-related."

item.title: BREAKING: Qatar, UAE pushing for diplomatic off-ramp after Qataris back US, down Iranian jets

item.title: DANIEL HAYWORTH: Trump's high-stakes Iran war puts his legacy and the US on the line
item.description: If the US wins big, this becomes the most consequential foreign policy victory since the Berlin Wall fell.

item.title: BREAKING: Iran shuts down Strait of Hormuz, threatens to torch any ship that enters it: IRGC
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz handles roughly one-fifth of global oil shipments.

item.title: US sinks all 11 of Iran's ships in Gulf of Oman: CENTCOM
